recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Any future changes to displayLanguage fallback warnings or broader terminology behavior should proceed under a final later Vocab issue rather than changing this already-applied DSTU2 parameter addition.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Vocab change request asking for ValueSet validation and code lookup to accept a language parameter, useful when validating or returning the display associated with a code; resolution was to add it to $validate and $lookup.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the work was already done under another task. The matching 2016 git-svn commit 3a0587b8a7b779c25869a391ce9596b59ddfbf08, titled '#add displayLanguage parameter to $validate-code and $lookup', added validate-code.displayLanguage to the old ValueSet spreadsheet and lookup.displayLanguage to the old CodeSystem spreadsheet. Later source refactors preserved these as OperationDefinition XML files.
additional_context: ValueSet and CodeSystem are active resources in source/fhir.ini and their operation lists include OperationDefinition/ValueSet-validate-code and OperationDefinition/CodeSystem-lookup. Later final issues FHIR-29958 and FHIR-40770 refined the same displayLanguage parameter family without reversing the original addition; FHIR-57437 is a later Submitted/unresolved proposal about fallback warnings and is only background.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already defines displayLanguage as an input on ValueSet/$validate-code and CodeSystem/$lookup, and the parallel CodeSystem/$validate-code definition is also aligned by an existing combined-branch FHIR-40770 reconciliation.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive issue corrected CodeSystem $lookup displayLanguage documentation to reference CodeSystem.concept.designation.language.
Later Applied/Persuasive issue made $validate-code displayLanguage repeatable and clarified validation semantics; it is already represented on the combined branch.
Submitted/unresolved later proposal about warnings when displayLanguage fallback occurs; not a final decision.
